description: Find a CFTC designated contract market (DCM) or pending application by exchange code or name substring in the MORVS Prediction Market Register. Returns CFTC-listed status/date and fixed-phrase remark flags, filing counts by listed year/category/status, stay and withdrawal counts, approval-pending and perpetual-futures counts, code-map evidence and open federal comment periods. Pending means only pending; a stay is a CFTC remark, not a finding. Filing counts measure filing practice, not markets, trading, users or odds. Dates are as listed by the CFTC and may be re-dated.

exchange.description: Required DCM code or case-insensitive exchange name substring; a pending application is only pending.

name: prediction_market_exchange
title: Get Prediction Market Exchange
